title: CI, Fuzzing, Clean Clone, Security, and Reproducibility
negative_results: arbitrary fuzzed input (digits, dashes, unicode, punctuation, empty, canonical-looking, garbage) never crashes ingest + decode; every input yields a typed FuzzOutcome (DECODE, ALIAS_SET, or REFUSAL) and never a forced pin
bad generator arguments (non-int seed, negative n) are typed FuzzError refusals
no public cwatlas module source contains a private path/identity token

claims.statement: A seeded fuzz harness generates arbitrary raw vector strings that always yield a typed result through ingest + decode and never crash; the same seed produces identical inputs and outcomes across two runs (determinism); and every cwatlas module imports cleanly from a fresh clone (POWER).

privacy_check: CLEAN - seeded synthetic inputs only; a source-wide scan asserts no public module leaks a private token; the harness asserts no geographic/physical claim
